name: Hypnos-i2-32B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-32B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, uniform full attention on all 64 layers (no sliding window, no hybrid)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-32B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 32 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-12-03.
